people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
